# Data Safety & Validation Checklist: Removable Media Export

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for data-safety and validation flows (edge cases, error paths, device constraints, warning dialogs, state machine completeness)

**Created**: 2026-11-19

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (Feature 004: Removable Media Export)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.

**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## Requirement Completeness: Error Scenarios

- [ ] CHK001 Are all edge cases listed in spec §Edge Cases mapped to explicit FR or SC requirements? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK002 Is mid-operation device disconnection error handling specified with detection timeout (5 sec) and user recovery path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, SC-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all device validation failure modes (non-removable, write-protected, too small, insufficient space) documented with user-facing error messages? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the behavior for "no removable devices connected" explicitly specified (empty list, message text, UI button disabled)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK005 Are partial failure scenarios (export mid-operation → partial files remain) documented with user remediation steps? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Edge Cases]

## Requirement Completeness: Validation Rules

- [ ] CHK006 Are all Device struct validation constraints from data-model.md cited in corresponding FR/SC (capacity_bytes > 0, is_removable=true, is_write_protected=false)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, FR-006, FR-010]
- [ ] CHK007 Are ExportJob state machine transitions explicitly enumerated for all valid state pairs (PENDING→FORMATTING, FORMATTING→IN_PROGRESS, etc.)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the reformat confirmation prerequisite (reformat_enabled=true REQUIRES reformat_confirmed=true) explicitly stated in requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK009 Are space estimation and insufficiency warning requirements specified with check point (before format/export starts) and user choice (retry subset or cancel)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Clarity: Warning Dialog

- [ ] CHK010 Is the reformat warning dialog wording specified verbatim or with exact requirements (what text, device name included, data-loss message present)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "prominent warning dialog" quantified with visual/modal specification (modal blocks further action until confirm/cancel)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, SC-002]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the "dismissible warning" behavior defined (which button dismisses: Cancel only, or both Cancel + X)? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 Can the success criteria "no accidental reformats possible" be objectively verified (i.e., what test proves accidental reformat cannot occur)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]

## Requirement Clarity: Device Constraints

- [ ] CHK014 Is "write-protected device" detection behavior specified (when detected: before or during write attempt, error message exact wording)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "non-removable device" defined with rejection criteria (must cite is_removable=true constraint from data-model.md)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the "internal drives" rejection requirement distinguished from "system partitions" rejection (same rule or separate)? [Clarity, Gap]

## Requirement Consistency: Workflows

- [ ] CHK017 Are Save (local project file) and Export (to device) workflows documented as independent with no side effects between them? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, US3]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the state machine transitions for "user cancels during reformat" vs "user cancels during export" explicitly different or identical? [Consistency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the "retry export after partial failure" requirement specify what state ExportJob should return to (PENDING or IN_PROGRESS)? [Consistency, Gap]

## Requirement Measurability: Performance & Responsiveness

- [ ] CHK020 Is "app remains responsive during export" quantified with exact metrics (progress update interval ≥500ms, max UI freeze duration)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012, SC-008]
- [ ] CHK021 Is "device disconnection detected within 5 seconds" testable with a specific test scenario (e.g., unplug USB during file copy, measure time to error display)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK022 Is "export completes within 30 seconds" measurable and testable with a defined playlist size and device speed assumption? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## Requirement Coverage: Platform Specificity

- [ ] CHK023 Are platform-specific device detection APIs mentioned or deferred? (spec says platform-native but does not name APIs) [Gap, Plan §Architecture]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the "eject device" operation specified as platform-appropriate but does not mandate specific commands? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK025 Are cross-platform test scenarios (USB 2.0, USB 3.0, SD card reader on Windows/macOS/Linux) explicit in SC-005 or test plan? [Coverage, Spec §SC-005]

## Requirement Assumptions & Preconditions

- [ ] CHK026 Is user permission to write to removable devices documented as an assumption (OS-level permissions granted)? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the v1 filesystem support scope (FAT32, exFAT only; NTFS deferred to v2) stated to prevent scope creep during implementation? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Are project file location defaults and override mechanism specified (default to current working directory, File > Save As override)? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001–CHK028) for easy reference
- Focus areas: Data Safety (edge cases, error paths), Validation (constraints, state machine), Warning UX (clarity, modality), Platform Coverage (cross-platform testing assumptions)
